spans.s: धीर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Wise, learned, clever, intelligent, धृतेश्च धीरः सदृशीर्व्यधत्त सः R.iii.10; 2. steady, steadfast, durable, R.ii.6; 3. resolute, persevering, of firm mind, विकारहेतौ सति विक्रियंते येषां न चेतांसि त एव धीराः K.S.i.59; 4. energetic, strong; 5. courageous, brave, bold; 6. composed, calm, collected; 7. well-behaved; 8. grave, solemn, R.xviii.4; 9. deep, hollow, loud (as sound), स्वरेण धीरेण निवर्तयन्निव R.iii.43; 10. lazy, dull; 11. gentle, slow; 12. pleasing, beautiful, attractive, धीरसमीरे यमुनातीरे Git.G.v.
धीर (II) m. 1. The ocean; 2. an epithet of king Bali.
धीर (III) n. Saffron.(धीरम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘firmly, steadily, steadfastly,’ Am.

धीर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Wise, learned, clever, intelligent, धृतेश्च धीरः सदृशीर्व्यधत्त सः R.iii.10; 2. steady, steadfast, durable, R.ii.6; 3. resolute, persevering, of firm mind, विकारहेतौ सति विक्रियंते येषां न चेतांसि त एव धीराः K.S.i.59; 4. energetic, strong; 5. courageous, brave, bold; 6. composed, calm, collected; 7. well-behaved; 8. grave, solemn, R.xviii.4; 9. deep, hollow, loud (as sound), स्वरेण धीरेण निवर्तयन्निव R.iii.43; 10. lazy, dull; 11. gentle, slow; 12. pleasing, beautiful, attractive, धीरसमीरे यमुनातीरे Git.G.v.
धीरा f. The heroine of a poetic composition, who though jealous of her husband or lover suppresses all outward expression of her resentment in his presence (व्यंग्यकोपप्रकाशिका धीरा).
धीर-उदात्त m. the hero of a poetic composition who is brave and noble-minded. (He is thus defined- अविकत्थनः क्षमावानतिगंभीरो महासत्वः । स्थेयान्निगूढमानो धीरोदात्तो दृढव्रतः कथितः.)
धीर-उद्धत m. the hero of a poetic composition who is brave but haughty and boastful (thus defined- मायापरः प्रचंडश्चपलोऽहंकारदर्पभूयिष्ठः । आत्मश्लाघानिरतो धीरैर्धीरोद्धतः कथितः).
धीर-प्रशांत m. the hero of a poetic composition who is brave and calm (thus defined- सामान्यगुणैर्भूयान् द्विजादिको धीरप्रशांतः स्यात्).
धीर-ललित m. the hero of a poetic composition who is brave but sportive and reckless (thus defined- निश्चिंतो मृदुरनिशं कलापरो धीरललितः स्यात्).

धीरता f. 1. Fortitude (physical or moral), सहजामप्यपहाय धीरतां (विललाप) R.viii.43; 2. gravity, solemnity (as indicated by silence &c.), प्रत्यादेशान्न (v.l. शं न) खलु भवतो धीरतां कल्पयामि Megh.ii.51. For other meanings, See धैर्य.
धीरा-अधीरा f. the heroine of a poetic piece who being jealous of her husband or lover, alternately expresses and conceals her jealousy (व्यंग्याव्यंग्यकोपप्रकाशिका धीराधीरा).
